# Youssef Hassan — Portfolio (Flutter Web)

> Official public portfolio for Youssef Hassan, Flutter developer (Egypt). Use this file for a concise machine-readable summary of the site.

## Site URL

- Home: https://youssefsalem582.github.io/Youssef-Hassan-Portfolio/

## What this site is

Personal engineering portfolio: responsive Flutter Web app (PWA-capable) deployed on GitHub Pages. Sections cover about, skills, experience, projects (with per-project case studies), certificates, and a contact form.

## Language

User interface is available in **English** and **Arabic** (locale toggle in-app).

## Technology

- **Stack:** Flutter Web, `go_router`, `flutter_bloc`, `get_it`, ARB localization.
- **Hosting:** GitHub Pages; base path `/Youssef-Hassan-Portfolio/`.
